name: "Configure buildx with Namespace Cloud" Action For GitHub Actions
description: Configure buildx to use the Namespace Cloud build cluster

builder-name.description: The name of the local Docker build driver to be configured.

load-to-docker.description: Whether to load images to local docker engine

wait-for-builder.description: If true, creates the build clusters eagerly and waits for them to be available

experimental.description: A set of experimental configurations passed to builder configuration.

tag.description: If set, select this named builder. Contact support@namespace.so to get access.
